The '''''Blackstar''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship and her crew were part of the [[Invids]]. It was stationed on [[Courkrus]], and was one of the last ships to leave when [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] "avenging Jedi" appeared.
